│  **Date:** August 21, 2026 | **Weather:** 25-30°C, 90% rain probability                                                                                                         │
│  **Daily Budget Estimate:** ~$95 USD                                                                                                                                            │

│  **Morning (9:00 AM - 12:00 PM)**                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │

│     - **Cost:** ~$15 USD (500 THB entrance)                                                                                                                                     │
│     - **Duration:** 2.5 hours                                                                                                                                                   │

│     - **Cost:** ~$8 USD                                                                                                                                                         │
│     - **Duration:** 30 minutes                                                                                                                                                  │
│     - **Note:** River-view café with covered seating. Perfect rainy-day refuge with views of Wat Arun across the water.                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  **Afternoon (1:00 PM - 5:00 PM)**                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  3. **Lunch at Thip Samai (Pad Thai Legend)**                                                                                                                                   │
│     - **Cost:** ~$10 USD                                                                                                                                                        │
│     - **Duration:** 1 hour                                                                                                                                                      │
│     - **Note:** Bangkok's most famous pad Thai restaurant. Indoor seating, no reservations needed. Try their signature "wrapped in egg" version.                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  4. **Jim Thompson House Museum**                                                                                                                                               │
│     - **Cost:** ~$7 USD (200 THB)                                                                                                                                               │
│     - **Duration:** 1.5 hours                                                                                                                                                   │
│     - **Note:** Beautiful indoor museum showcasing traditional Thai architecture and silk collection. Guided tours included. Most pathways are covered.                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  5. **MBK Center Shopping & Exploration**                                                                                                                                       │
│     - **Cost:** Free entry; ~$20 USD for shopping/snacks                                                                                                                        │
│     - **Duration:** 2 hours                                                                                                                                                     │
│     - **Note:** Eight-floor indoor mall perfect for rainy weather. Great for souvenirs, local snacks, and people-watching. Air-conditioned comfort!                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  **Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM)**                                                                                                                                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  6. **Dinner at Somtum Der**                                                                                                                                                    │
│     - **Cost:** ~$15 USD                                                                                                                                                        │
│     - **Duration:** 1.5 hours                                                                                                                                                   │
│     - **Note:** Authentic Isaan cuisine in a covered setting. Try their famous papaya salad and grilled chicken. Michelin Bib Gourmand restaurant.                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │

│     - **Cost:** Free entry; ~$20 USD for activities/drinks                                                                                                                      │
│     - **Duration:** 2 hours                                                                                                                                                     │
│     - **Note:** Indoor-outdoor night market with covered walkways. Take the free shuttle boat (covered). Shops, restaurants, and entertainment venues offer shelter from rain.  │

│  ## Practical Tips for Rainy Season Bangkok                                                                                                                                     │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  ✅ **What to Pack:**                                                                                                                                                           │
│  - Compact umbrella and/or light rain jacket                                                                                                                                    │
│  - Waterproof bag or cover for electronics                                                                                                                                      │
│  - Quick-dry clothing and extra socks                                                                                                                                           │
│  - Closed-toe sandals or waterproof shoes                                                                                                                                       │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  ✅ **Getting Around:**                                                                                                                                                         │
│  - BTS Skytrain & MRT subway (covered, air-conditioned): ~$1-2 per trip                                                                                                         │
│  - Grab taxi app: Essential for rainy days, ~$3-8 per trip                                                                                                                      │
│  - Avoid tuk-tuks during heavy rain                                                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  ✅ **Money Matters:**                                                                                                                                                          │
│  - ATMs widely available (180-220 THB fee)                                                                                                                                      │
│  - Credit cards accepted at malls, hotels, restaurants                                                                                                                          │
│  - Keep cash (200-500 THB) for temples, markets, street food                                                                                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  ✅ **Rain Strategy:**                                                                                                                                                          │
│  - Morning showers typically 8-10 AM, afternoon 2-4 PM, evening 6-8 PM                                                                                                          │
│  - Plan indoor activities during peak rain hours                                                                                                                                │
│  - Most attractions stay open during rain                                                                                                                                       │
│  - Temple visits best early morning or late afternoon                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  ✅ **Health & Safety:**                                                                                                                                                        │
│  - Stay hydrated despite cooler rain temps                                                                                                                                      │
│  - Watch for slippery temple stairs and sidewalks                                                                                                                               │
│  - Avoid street food stalls during heavy downpours                                                                                                                              │
│  - Most malls have first aid stations                                                                                                                                           │

│  ## Day 1: Indoor Cultural & Culinary Discovery                                                                                                                                 │
│  **Date:** August 21, 2026 | **Weather:** 25-30°C, 90% rain probability                                                                                                         │
│  **Daily Budget Estimate:** ~$95 USD                                                                                                                                            │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  **Morning (9:00 AM - 12:00 PM)**                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  1. **Grand Palace & Wat Phra Kaew** *(Indoor/Covered替代)*                                                                                                                     │
│     - **Cost:** ~$15 USD (500 THB entrance)                                                                                                                                     │
│     - **Duration:** 2.5 hours                                                                                                                                                   │
│     - **Note:** Magnificent covered temple complex with sheltered walkways. Dress modestly (shoulders and knees covered). The emerald Buddha and ornate architecture are        │
│  must-sees, and most areas offer rain protection.                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  2. **Coffee Break at The Deck Café**                                                                                                                                           │
│     - **Cost:** ~$8 USD                                                                                                                                                         │
│     - **Duration:** 30 minutes                                                                                                                                                  │
│     - **Note:** River-view café with covered seating. Perfect rainy-day refuge with views of Wat Arun across the water.                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  **Afternoon (1:00 PM - 5:00 PM)**                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  3. **Lunch at Thip Samai (Pad Thai Legend)**                                                                                                                                   │
│     - **Cost:** ~$10 USD                                                                                                                                                        │
│     - **Duration:** 1 hour                                                                                                                                                      │
│     - **Note:** Bangkok's most famous pad Thai restaurant. Indoor seating, no reservations needed. Try their signature "wrapped in egg" version.                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  4. **Jim Thompson House Museum**                                                                                                                                               │
│     - **Cost:** ~$7 USD (200 THB)                                                                                                                                               │
│     - **Duration:** 1.5 hours                                                                                                                                                   │
│     - **Note:** Beautiful indoor museum showcasing traditional Thai architecture and silk collection. Guided tours included. Most pathways are covered.                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  5. **MBK Center Shopping & Exploration**                                                                                                                                       │
│     - **Cost:** Free entry; ~$20 USD for shopping/snacks                                                                                                                        │
│     - **Duration:** 2 hours                                                                                                                                                     │
│     - **Note:** Eight-floor indoor mall perfect for rainy weather. Great for souvenirs, local snacks, and people-watching. Air-conditioned comfort!                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  **Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM)**                                                                                                                                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  6. **Dinner at Somtum Der**                                                                                                                                                    │
│     - **Cost:** ~$15 USD                                                                                                                                                        │
│     - **Duration:** 1.5 hours                                                                                                                                                   │
│     - **Note:** Authentic Isaan cuisine in a covered setting. Try their famous papaya salad and grilled chicken. Michelin Bib Gourmand restaurant.                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  7. **Asiatique The Riverfront**                                                                                                                                                │
│     - **Cost:** Free entry; ~$20 USD for activities/drinks                                                                                                                      │
│     - **Duration:** 2 hours                                                                                                                                                     │
│     - **Note:** Indoor-outdoor night market with covered walkways. Take the free shuttle boat (covered). Shops, restaurants, and entertainment venues offer shelter from rain.  │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  **Transportation:** ~$0 (walking/included in activities)                                                                                                                       │
│  **Day 1 Total:** ~$95 USD                                                                                                                                                      │

│  ## Day 2: Markets, Malls & Modern Bangkok                                                                                                                                      │
│  **Date:** August 22, 2026 | **Weather:** 26-30°C, 93% rain probability (heaviest rain day)                                                                                     │
│  **Daily Budget Estimate:** ~$98 USD                                                                                                                                            │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  **Morning (8:30 AM - 12:00 PM)**                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  1. **Breakfast at After You Dessert Café**                                                                                                                                     │
│     - **Cost:** ~$10 USD                                                                                                                                                        │
│     - **Duration:** 45 minutes                                                                                                                                                  │
│     - **Note:** Famous indoor café chain. Try their Shibuya honey toast. Multiple locations with covered access.                                                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  2. **Chatuchak Weekend Market (Covered Sections Only)**                                                                                                                        │
│     - **Cost:** Free entry; ~$25 USD for shopping                                                                                                                               │
│     - **Duration:** 3 hours                                                                                                                                                     │
│     - **Note:** **Only if visiting on weekend!** Stick to covered zones and indoor shops. Bring rain gear. Alternatively, visit **Union Mall** nearby (fully indoor) for        │
│  similar shopping experience.                                                                                                                                                   │

│  **Afternoon (1:00 PM - 5:30 PM)**                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │

│     - **Cost:** ~$12 USD                                                                                                                                                        │
│     - **Duration:** 1 hour                                                                                                                                                      │
│     - **Note:** Premium indoor food market with covered seating. Often called "world's best fresh market." Try seasonal fruits and ready-to-eat Thai dishes.                    │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  4. **Museum of Contemporary Art (MOCA)**                                                                                                                                       │
│     - **Cost:** ~$7 USD (200 THB)                                                                                                                                               │
│     - **Duration:** 2 hours                                                                                                                                                     │
│     - **Note:** Fully indoor, air-conditioned museum. Five floors of Thai contemporary art. Taxi recommended (~$8 USD from Or Tor Kor included in transport budget).            │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  5. **Central World & Erawan Shrine Visit**                                                                                                                                     │
│     - **Cost:** Free entry; ~$15 USD shopping/snacks                                                                                                                            │
│     - **Duration:** 1.5 hours                                                                                                                                                   │
│     - **Note:** Southeast Asia's largest mall (indoor). Quick outdoor shrine visit possible between rain showers (covered altar available).                                     │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  **Evening (6:30 PM - 9:30 PM)**                                                                                                                                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │

│     - **Cost:** ~$25 USD (lunch tasting menu alternative)                                                                                                                       │
│     - **Duration:** 2 hours                                                                                                                                                     │
│     - **Note:** Michelin-starred modern Thai cuisine. Indoor fine dining. Advance booking recommended. For budget option: **Krua Apsorn** ($12) nearby.                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  7. **Rooftop Bar Experience (Covered Options)**                                                                                                                                │
│     - **Cost:** ~$20 USD (2-3 drinks)                                                                                                                                           │
│     - **Duration:** 1.5 hours                                                                                                                                                   │

│  ## Day 3: Cultural Temples & Riverside                                                                                                                                         │
│  **Date:** August 23, 2026 | **Weather:** 26-31°C, 88% rain probability                                                                                                         │
│  **Daily Budget Estimate:** ~$97 USD                                                                                                                                            │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  **Morning (8:00 AM - 12:00 PM)**                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  1. **Breakfast at On Lok Yun**                                                                                                                                                 │
│     - **Cost:** ~$6 USD                                                                                                                                                         │
│     - **Duration:** 45 minutes                                                                                                                                                  │
│     - **Note:** Historic indoor café with old-world charm. Try traditional Thai-Chinese breakfast with kaya toast and soft-boiled eggs.                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  2. **Wat Pho (Temple of the Reclining Buddha)**                                                                                                                                │
│     - **Cost:** ~$7 USD (200 THB)                                                                                                                                               │
│     - **Duration:** 2 hours                                                                                                                                                     │
│     - **Note:** Mostly covered temple complex. The reclining Buddha is indoors. Traditional Thai massage available here (~$15 USD extra, indoors).                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  3. **Wat Arun (Temple of Dawn)**                                                                                                                                               │
│     - **Cost:** ~$2 USD (50 THB + ferry ~30 THB)                                                                                                                                │
│     - **Duration:** 1 hour                                                                                                                                                      │
│     - **Note:** Cross river by covered ferry. Temple has some covered areas, but climbing might be slippery when wet. Best viewed from across river during rain.                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  **Afternoon (1:00 PM - 5:00 PM)**                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  4. **Lunch at Supanniga Eating Room**                                                                                                                                          │
│     - **Cost:** ~$18 USD                                                                                                                                                        │
│     - **Duration:** 1.5 hours                                                                                                                                                   │
│     - **Note:** Upscale Thai restaurant, indoor seating with river views. Known for Eastern Thai cuisine. Reservation recommended.                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  5. **IconSiam Mall & Museum**                                                                                                                                                  │
│     - **Cost:** Free entry; ~$20 USD shopping/activities                                                                                                                        │
│     - **Duration:** 2.5 hours                                                                                                                                                   │
│     - **Note:** Bangkok's newest mega-mall (indoor). SookSiam indoor floating market on ground floor. Free boat shuttle from Saphan Taksin BTS (covered pier).                  │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  6. **Siam Niramit Cultural Show** *(Alternative)*                                                                                                                              │
│     - **Cost:** ~$25 USD (show only)                                                                                                                                            │
│     - **Duration:** 1.5 hours                                                                                                                                                   │
│     - **Note:** Indoor theater with spectacular Thai cultural performance. Air-conditioned venue perfect for rainy afternoon. Includes traditional village tour (partially      │
│  covered).                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  **Evening (6:30 PM - 9:00 PM)**                                                                                                                                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  7. **Dinner River Cruise** *(Weather Permitting)*                                                                                                                              │
│     - **Cost:** ~$35 USD                                                                                                                                                        │
│     - **Duration:** 2 hours                                                                                                                                                     │
│     - **Note:** Enclosed, air-conditioned dinner cruise boats operate rain or shine. Chao Phraya Princess or similar. Buffet dinner with illuminated temple views. **Budget     │
│  alternative:** Riverside restaurant like **Yok Yor Marina** ($15).                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  8. **Nightcap at Warehouse 30**                                                                                                                                                │
│     - **Cost:** ~$12 USD                                                                                                                                                        │
│     - **Duration:** 1 hour                                                                                                                                                      │
│     - **Note:** Creative hub with indoor cafés and bars. Covered outdoor spaces. Relaxed atmosphere for your final Bangkok evening.                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  **Transportation:** ~$7 USD (BTS/MRT/ferry)                                                                                                                                    │
│  **Day 3 Total:** ~$97 USD                                                                                                                                                      │

│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  ## Practical Tips for Rainy Season Bangkok                                                                                                                                     │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  ✅ **What to Pack:**                                                                                                                                                           │
│  - Compact umbrella and/or light rain jacket                                                                                                                                    │
│  - Waterproof bag or cover for electronics                                                                                                                                      │
│  - Quick-dry clothing and extra socks                                                                                                                                           │
│  - Closed-toe sandals or waterproof shoes                                                                                                                                       │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  ✅ **Getting Around:**                                                                                                                                                         │
│  - BTS Skytrain & MRT subway (covered, air-conditioned): ~$1-2 per trip                                                                                                         │
│  - Grab taxi app: Essential for rainy days, ~$3-8 per trip                                                                                                                      │
│  - Avoid tuk-tuks during heavy rain                                                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  ✅ **Money Matters:**                                                                                                                                                          │
│  - ATMs widely available (180-220 THB fee)                                                                                                                                      │
│  - Credit cards accepted at malls, hotels, restaurants                                                                                                                          │
│  - Keep cash (200-500 THB) for temples, markets, street food                                                                                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  ✅ **Rain Strategy:**                                                                                                                                                          │
│  - Morning showers typically 8-10 AM, afternoon 2-4 PM, evening 6-8 PM                                                                                                          │
│  - Plan indoor activities during peak rain hours                                                                                                                                │
│  - Most attractions stay open during rain                                                                                                                                       │
│  - Temple visits best early morning or late afternoon                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  ✅ **Health & Safety:**                                                                                                                                                        │
│  - Stay hydrated despite cooler rain temps                                                                                                                                      │
│  - Watch for slippery temple stairs and sidewalks                                                                                                                               │
│  - Avoid street food stalls during heavy downpours                                                                                                                              │
│  - Most malls have first aid stations                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  ---                                                                                                                                                                            │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │

│    - **Cost:** $65 USD per person                                                                                                                                               │
│    - **Timing:** 3 hours including transport                                                                                                                                    │

│    - **Cost:** $10 USD                                                                                                                                                          │

│    - Self-guided exploration of the famous main square                                                                                                                          │
│    - **Cost:** Free (budget $5 for mint tea and snacks)                                                                                                                         │
│    - **Note:** The square comes alive in late afternoon; watch street performers and soak in the atmosphere                                                                     │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  **Evening:**                                                                                                                                                                   │
│  - **Dinner in the Medina** (7:00 PM - 8:30 PM)                                                                                                                                 │
│    - **Cost:** $12 USD                                                                                                                                                          │

│  **Evening:**                                                                                                                                                                   │
│  - **Rooftop Dinner with View** (7:30 PM - 9:00 PM)                                                                                                                             │
│    - **Cost:** $20 USD                                                                                                                                                          │

│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  Welcome to Rome, Italy's vibrant capital and the heart of the Lazio region! As the third most populous city in the European Union with 2.7 million residents and a sprawling   │
│  metropolitan area of over 4 million people, Rome offers an incredible blend of ancient history and modern Italian life. Known as the "Eternal City" and famous for its seven   │

│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  # 6-Day Barcelona Itinerary                                                                                                                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  ## Day 1 - Arrival & Garden Relaxation                                                                                                                                         │
│  **Daily Estimated Cost: $65-85**                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  ### Morning/Afternoon                                                                                                                                                          │
│  - **Jardins d'Elisard Sala** (10:00-21:00)                                                                                                                                     │
│    - **Cost**: Free entry                                                                                                                                                       │
│    - **Time**: 2-3 hours                                                                                                                                                        │
│    - **Note**: A peaceful garden retreat perfect for easing into Barcelona time. Bring water and enjoy the local flora. Great for photos and a quiet stroll after your          │
│  journey.                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  ### Lunch                                                                                                                                                                      │
│  - **Local café near the gardens**                                                                                                                                              │
│    - **Cost**: $15-20                                                                                                                                                           │
│    - **Note**: Grab a menú del día (daily menu) for authentic local cuisine at budget-friendly prices.                                                                          │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  ### Afternoon/Evening                                                                                                                                                          │
│  - **Neighborhood exploration & dinner**                                                                                                                                        │
│    - **Cost**: $30-40                                                                                                                                                           │
│    - **Note**: Wander the surrounding area, find a tapas bar, and enjoy your first evening soaking in the Barcelona atmosphere.                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  ### Transportation                                                                                                                                                             │
│  - **Airport transfer + metro day pass**                                                                                                                                        │
│    - **Cost**: $20-25                                                                                                                                                           │
│    - **Note**: Consider the Aerobus ($6-7) or metro ($5) from airport, plus a T-Casual card for 10 metro trips ($12).                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  ---                                                                                                                                                                            │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  ## Day 2 - Gothic Quarter & Las Ramblas                                                                                                                                        │
│  **Daily Estimated Cost: $75-95**                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  ### Morning                                                                                                                                                                    │
│  - **Gothic Quarter (Barri Gòtic) Walking Tour**                                                                                                                                │
│    - **Cost**: Free (self-guided) or $20-25 (guided tour)                                                                                                                       │
│    - **Time**: 9:00-12:00                                                                                                                                                       │
│    - **Note**: Explore medieval streets, Barcelona Cathedral exterior, and Plaça del Rei. Start early to beat crowds and heat.                                                  │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  ### Lunch                                                                                                                                                                      │
│  - **La Boqueria Market**                                                                                                                                                       │
│    - **Cost**: $15-25                                                                                                                                                           │
│    - **Time**: 12:30-14:00                                                                                                                                                      │
│    - **Note**: Sample fresh juices, jamón, and local specialties at this iconic food market just off Las Ramblas.                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  ### Afternoon                                                                                                                                                                  │
│  - **Las Ramblas stroll & Palau Güell**                                                                                                                                         │
│    - **Cost**: $12 (Palau Güell entry)                                                                                                                                          │
│    - **Time**: 14:30-17:00                                                                                                                                                      │
│    - **Note**: Walk the famous boulevard, then visit Gaudí's early masterpiece. Watch your belongings—pickpockets are active here.                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  ### Evening                                                                                                                                                                    │
│  - **Barceloneta Beach & seafood dinner**                                                                                                                                       │
│    - **Cost**: $30-40                                                                                                                                                           │
│    - **Time**: 18:00-21:00                                                                                                                                                      │
│    - **Note**: Relax by the Mediterranean, watch the sunset, and enjoy fresh paella or grilled fish at a beachfront restaurant.                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  ---                                                                                                                                                                            │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  ## Day 3 - Gaudí's Masterpieces                                                                                                                                                │
│  **Daily Estimated Cost: $95-120**                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  ### Morning                                                                                                                                                                    │
│  - **Sagrada Familia**                                                                                                                                                          │
│    - **Cost**: $40-45 (basic ticket with audio guide)                                                                                                                           │
│    - **Time**: 9:00-11:30                                                                                                                                                       │
│    - **Note**: Book tickets online weeks in advance! Choose earliest time slot to avoid crowds. Allow 2-3 hours for this breathtaking basilica.                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  ### Lunch                                                                                                                                                                      │
│  - **Eixample district café**                                                                                                                                                   │
│    - **Cost**: $18-25                                                                                                                                                           │
│    - **Time**: 12:00-13:30                                                                                                                                                      │
│    - **Note**: Try local Catalan dishes like escalivada or botifarra in the modernist neighborhood.                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  ### Afternoon                                                                                                                                                                  │
│  - **Casa Batlló OR La Pedrera (Casa Milà)**                                                                                                                                    │
│    - **Cost**: $30-35 (one monument)                                                                                                                                            │
│    - **Time**: 14:30-16:30                                                                                                                                                      │
│    - **Note**: Choose one to stay on budget. Both are stunning Gaudí buildings. La Pedrera has a fantastic rooftop.                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  ### Evening                                                                                                                                                                    │
│  - **Passeig de Gràcia window shopping & dinner**                                                                                                                               │
│    - **Cost**: $7-15 (gelato/drinks) + dinner not included                                                                                                                      │
│    - **Time**: 17:00-20:00                                                                                                                                                      │
│    - **Note**: Stroll Barcelona's most elegant avenue, admire architecture, and grab a casual bite or plan dinner independently.                                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  ---                                                                                                                                                                            │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  ## Day 4 - Montjuïc Hill & Culture                                                                                                                                             │
│  **Daily Estimated Cost: $70-90**                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  ### Morning                                                                                                                                                                    │
│  - **Montjuïc Castle (Castell de Montjuïc)**                                                                                                                                    │
│    - **Cost**: $6 (entry)                                                                                                                                                       │
│    - **Time**: 10:00-12:00                                                                                                                                                      │
│    - **Note**: Take the cable car up ($9 round-trip) for spectacular city views and explore this historic fortress.                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  ### Lunch                                                                                                                                                                      │
│  - **Montjuïc café or packed picnic**                                                                                                                                           │
│    - **Cost**: $12-18                                                                                                                                                           │
│    - **Time**: 12:30-13:30                                                                                                                                                      │
│    - **Note**: Several affordable spots on the hill, or bring supplies from a local supermarket.                                                                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  ### Afternoon                                                                                                                                                                  │
│  - **Museu Nacional d'Art de Catalunya (MNAC)**                                                                                                                                 │
│    - **Cost**: $15 (general admission, free first Sunday of month)                                                                                                              │
│    - **Time**: 14:00-17:00                                                                                                                                                      │
│    - **Note**: World-class Romanesque art collection. Don't miss the rooftop terrace viewpoint!                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  ### Evening                                                                                                                                                                    │
│  - **Magic Fountain show & dinner**                                                                                                                                             │
│    - **Cost**: Free (fountain) + $30-40 (dinner)                                                                                                                                │
│    - **Time**: Check schedule (usually 21:00-22:00 in summer)                                                                                                                   │
│    - **Note**: The Font Màgica light and music show is spectacular. Arrive 20-30 minutes early for good viewing spots.                                                          │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  ---                                                                                                                                                                            │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  ## Day 5 - Park Güell & Local Neighborhoods                                                                                                                                    │
│  **Daily Estimated Cost: $80-100**                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  ### Morning                                                                                                                                                                    │
│  - **Park Güell**                                                                                                                                                               │
│    - **Cost**: $13 (monumental zone) or Free (free areas)                                                                                                                       │
│    - **Time**: 9:00-11:30                                                                                                                                                       │
│    - **Note**: Book timed entry online. The mosaic dragon and serpentine benches are iconic. Arrive at opening for best photos and fewer crowds.                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  ### Lunch                                                                                                                                                                      │
│  - **Gràcia neighborhood tapas**                                                                                                                                                │
│    - **Cost**: $20-28                                                                                                                                                           │
│    - **Time**: 12:30-14:00                                                                                                                                                      │
│    - **Note**: Explore this bohemian district's charming plazas. Try Plaça del Sol or Plaça de la Vila for local atmosphere.                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  ### Afternoon                                                                                                                                                                  │
│  - **Picasso Museum**                                                                                                                                                           │
│    - **Cost**: $14 (general admission, free Thursdays 18:00-21:30)                                                                                                              │
│    - **Time**: 15:00-17:30                                                                                                                                                      │
│    - **Note**: Pre-book online to skip lines. Excellent collection of Picasso's formative works in medieval palaces.                                                            │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  ### Evening                                                                                                                                                                    │
│  - **El Born neighborhood & dinner**                                                                                                                                            │
│    - **Cost**: $30-35                                                                                                                                                           │
│    - **Time**: 18:30-21:30                                                                                                                                                      │
│    - **Note**: Trendy area with excellent restaurants, bars, and the stunning Santa Maria del Mar basilica. Perfect for evening wandering.                                      │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  ---                                                                                                                                                                            │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  ## Day 6 - Departure Day Leisure                                                                                                                                               │
│  **Daily Estimated Cost: $50-70**                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  ### Morning                                                                                                                                                                    │
│  - **Port Vell & Columbus Monument**                                                                                                                                            │
│    - **Cost**: Free (walking) or $7 (monument elevator)                                                                                                                         │
│    - **Time**: 9:00-11:00                                                                                                                                                       │
│    - **Note**: Easy morning stroll along the waterfront. Light activity perfect before departure.                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  ### Late Morning                                                                                                                                                               │
│  - **Maremagnum shopping center or last-minute souvenir hunting**                                                                                                               │
│    - **Cost**: $20-30 (souvenirs/gifts)                                                                                                                                         │
│    - **Time**: 11:00-13:00                                                                                                                                                      │
│    - **Note**: Pick up final gifts—olive oil, saffron, or FC Barcelona merchandise are popular choices.                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  ### Lunch                                                                                                                                                                      │
│  - **Final Barcelona meal**                                                                                                                                                     │
│    - **Cost**: $20-30                                                                                                                                                           │
│    - **Time**: 13:30-15:00                                                                                                                                                      │
│    - **Note**: Savor one last menú del día or your favorite dish discovered during the trip.                                                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  ### Afternoon                                                                                                                                                                  │
│  - **Airport transfer & departure**                                                                                                                                             │
│    - **Cost**: $7-15 (transport)                                                                                                                                                │
│    - **Note**: Allow 2-3 hours before flight. Aerobus runs every 5-10 minutes and takes 35 minutes to airport.                                                                  │
│                                                                                                                                                                                 │

│  ### Budget Notes:                                                                                                                                                              │
│  - **Not included**: Accommodation, travel insurance, most dinners (allowing flexibility for your preferences)                                                                  │
│  - **Money-saving tips**:                                                                                                                                                       │
│    - Buy a T-Casual metro card (10 rides for ~$12)                                                                                                                              │
│    - Many museums offer free entry on specific days/times                                                                                                                       │
│    - Menú del día lunch specials (3 courses) are great value at $12-18                                                                                                          │
│    - Book major attractions online in advance for best prices                                                                                                                   │
│  - **Additional funds recommended**: $40-60/day for dinner, drinks, and unexpected expenses                                                                                     │
